messages:
sam: EdgeWave ping 1 retro entitlement discrepancy for MayAug. partner claims ~3.2k units not billed. can we triage?
priya: on it. can they share a sample CSV or event id?
sam: sample id from partner: ew-evt-20250722-7c2a. partner CSV link attached in email.
marketplace-bot: Export available: s3://marketplace-exports/edgewave/2025-07/usage_export_20250731.json
james: likely suspects: sku mapping mismatch or hourly windowing. partner uses EW-100-SKU, our map is EW-HARDWARE-100 in edgewave.yml.
derek: i'll run a dry-run replay against staging: ./tools/replay_ingest --partner edgewave --from 2025-05-01 --to 2025-08-31 --dry-run and post summary.
priya: plan: 1) row counts of marketplace export vs partner CSV 2) join export -> raw_ingest -> ingestion_filters 3) produce unmatched CSV with reason codes (sku_mismatch/window_drop/policy)
nana: typo  i'm ana (legal)  Q: contract has 90-day cap on retro credits unless partner supplies device delivery proof. flag if events older than 90 days.
maria-finance: finance prefers credit memo for true corrections; adjustments beyond policy need legal evidence.
derek: dry-run done: approx 372 records would be accepted after remap. uploading diff: s3://redwood-temp/edgewave/replay-diff-3301234567.json
priya: reconciliation job result: partner rows 3,200, matched 2,828, unmatched 372. creating CSV of unmatched ids now.
james: i'll patch infra/partner_mappings/edgewave.yml and add unit test to prevent regression.
priya: unmatched CSV: s3://redwood-temp/edgewave/unmatched-3301234567.csv (rows: 372). reasons: ~240 sku_mismatch, ~90 window_drop, ~42 policy_filter.
sam: actions: sam -> partner comms; priya -> finalize CSV + reasoncodes; derek -> await approvals then run production replay; ana -> confirm legal stance re: 90-day cap; james -> patch mapping + tests; maria-finance -> prep credit memo template if needed.
priya: ETA for final reconciliation doc: EOD today. will update ticket RW-PRT-4588.
sam: thanks all. i'll notify EdgeWave that we found mapping/windowing causes and are preparing a replay/credit path depending on legal/finance.
(END)
